title: Weekly digest 2026-W45: 85 items this week
summary: Index of 85 items: Kouka 19, Lacia 13, Methode 33, Snowdrop 10, Saturnus 10.
summary_en: Weekly index of 85 items, sorted by column. Titles are listed as published; Chinese items carry their own English summaries in their cards.
body:
